source.author: ov
source.text: at bona posteritas puppem formavit in aere, hospitis adventum testificata dei.
source.text_original: at bona posteritas puppem formavit in aere, / hospitis adventum testificata dei.
source.text_english: But later generations fashioned a ship in bronze, bearing witness to the god’s arrival as a guest.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: cuius rei argumenta sunt nummi ueteres, in quibus est cum duplici fronte Ianus et in altera parte nauis, sicut idem poeta subiecit: at bona posteritas puppem formauit in aere hospitis aduentum testificata dei.
reuse.text_original: cuius rei argumenta sunt nummi ueteres, in quibus est cum duplici fronte Ianus et in altera parte nauis, sicut idem poeta subiecit: at bona posteritas puppem formauit in aere hospitis aduentum testificata dei.
reuse.text_english: Proof of this fact are the ancient coins, on which there is Janus with a double face and on the other side a ship, just as the same poet added: but grateful posterity fashioned the ship’s stern in bronze, bearing witness to the arrival of the god as a guest.
